_comment: The promotions package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.6). They name only its own types
and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every row is narrowed by PromotionsAccess
(the seller's Owners, Admins and 'promotions' members; platform admins, ManageSellers/Commerce, every row), so the
rights alone show nothing. Nothing is written by a form: only QueryRead is granted; the admin endpoints
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-promotions": false }.
